# Tempo DS fixture

These source copies come from [tempoxyz/ds at 8a03c7c](https://github.com/tempoxyz/ds/tree/8a03c7c85cfaa56377f224aa9f50d18c6a8e726e/src). They retain the actual core variables, platform projections, base/inverse sets, typography, and configuration. The MIT license is included.

Compiler and Metro tests consume these files as source text. Tests exercise native conversions and package delivery. Font mappings name registered application fonts and do not load assets. Bundle and callable checks do not establish device rendering or font registration.
